nodes.label: RBAC/Security Remediation Summary
nodes.description: 8-phase remediation: Phase 0 auth contract fix (/auth/me canonical response), Phase 1 RBAC foundation (roles/permissions/role_user tables, 4 roles: guest/user/admin/superadmin), Phase 2 RBAC integration (Role/Permission models, EnsureUserHasPermission middleware, AuditService, RoleController, policies updated), Phase 3 retire is_admin column, Phase 4 device credential security (SHA-256 hashing, rotation), Phase 5 stable IoT identity (device_sensor_mappings, reading_projections), Phase 6 unified ingestion provenance, Phase 7 alert/data integrity (AlertRuleValidationService), Phase 8 production maturity (audit_logs table). Frontend: auth store RBAC getters, route requiresPermission, permission-based UI visibility.
nodes.rationale: Documents the complete RBAC and security remediation implementation. Defines the permission system (device.view, sensor.create, alert.resolve, etc.), the authorization architecture (users → roles → permissions → policies), and the device credential hashing strategy.
